tiles: Generative baroque art study inspired by Jan Davidsz de Heem
Elegant tabletop with luminous fruit and deep chiaroscuro
Modern AI pipeline with painterly for museum-grade polish
challenge: Exploring the intersection of Baroque still life painting and contemporary AI-generated imagery. The challenge was to create compositions that honor the technical mastery and abundant detail of Jan Davidsz de Heem's fruit arrangements while leveraging modern generative tools to produce new interpretations with authentic chiaroscuro and color harmony.
approach: Used Adobe Firefly to generate base compositions inspired by De Heem's signature fruit-and-foliage arrangements. Each piece was refined through selective in-painting for highlight control, edge definition, and subtle texture, then graded in Lightroom for historically faithful color presence and dramatic lighting.
result: Produced a six-piece collection of high-resolution baroque still life prints that read as classically grounded at thumbnail scale and hold museum-grade detail at full resolution. The series demonstrates mastery of AI art direction while maintaining deep art historical knowledge.
